description: Free item/service search with no sign-in, by coordinates and optional city. Returns { envelope_version: 1, results, data_coverage, city? } and optional wider_search. Approved rows include id, title, businessId, displayName, listed price fields, distanceMeters, reach, source_type, freshness, data_age_seconds and nullable lastConfirmedAt/availability. Availability requires connector data within its freshness window, a non-listed plan, BILLING_ENTITLEMENTS_ENABLED=true and STRIPE_MODE=test/live. Website-name matches follow approved rows with unconfirmed labels, source URL and last-seen date, without price or availability. Empty results describe this query only. Preserve coverage, city warnings and contact/request-area next steps; virtual distance is null. Use discover_local for directory alternatives.
name: search_local_offerings
title: Search local offerings
